name: ifg
description: For tax professionals. Claude cites the official tax text in force on the date of the facts, with its status and a clickable link to the official source. Covers France, Luxembourg, Switzerland, Belgium, Germany, Monaco, Andorra and Italy, plus tax treaties, EU law and the OECD; more countries are coming, one by one. Missing texts are flagged, never invented. Requires an IFG account (7-day free trial).
